reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Finite-horizon existence, Borel selection, and policy validation
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: Compact state/action spaces; nonempty compact continuous feasible correspondence; continuous bounded primitives and transition; fixed-law monotone cash-invariant risk; the stated Borel kernel property for bounded Borel policy evaluation.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: Uniform continuity passes through the fixed-law monetary risk. Compact minimization and the explicit nested closed-ball construction supply a Borel minimizing policy. Backward induction proves value uniqueness and recursive policy validation. Stability is stated for continuous Bellman terminal continuations, with Borel fixed-policy comparison distinguished.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: This standard foundation is explicitly not novel and does not supply global well-posedness for an arbitrary singular recursive-utility objective.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Original primitive closure, strong continuation convexity, constrained actor and critic graph
reviewed_dependency_chain.location: Supplement Proposition 3 and following subsections; pages 47–53
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: The unchanged investment primitives, original feasible action interval, uniform scalar innovation, beta=15/16 and specified terminal implementation.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: The transition stays in the declared original domain. The joint curvature survives infimum over the affine capacity graph, giving state modulus (4-5 beta/4)/d and innovation modulus 181/64. Reparameterization a=A(x)v supplies the constrained envelope and boundary term. The 40-bit downward action rule remains feasible within the unchanged terminal allowance. The half-squared residual derivative includes direct, actor, generator, and shared-parameter channels.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: A fitted critic or a fixed architecture is not an optimizer convergence theorem; detached targets have their own derivative. The rounded implemented continuation need not be convex or differentiable.

reviewed_dependency_chain.location: Supplement Proposition 4; pages 53–55; retained bridge pages 40–43
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: The separately declared Brownian Markov model, regular trial function, admissible stopped state process, bounded terminal/boundary discrepancy, Lipschitz driver and stated BSDE comparison/integrability assumptions.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: Stopped Ito formula retains terminal/lateral error and the original driver. Linearization and conditional expectation yield the discounted residual account with the stopped boundary term. A zero interior residual cannot replace boundary data.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: This bridge is not a proof that general nonlinear recursive utility, singular Epstein–Zin preferences, NDU, or a fully coupled FBSDE is the implemented nested-AVaR investment objective.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Tail-uniform exact point-information upper and lower bounds
reviewed_dependency_chain.location: Main Theorem 9, pages 22–24; Supplement section 15, pages 55–58
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: Convex K-Lipschitz scalar continuation on [-R,R], original uniform law, exact deterministic point values; alpha in [0,1).
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: The adverse density is feasible even with atoms. H has monotone 2K-Lipschitz derivative; returning the midpoint of the final bisection bracket gives KR(1-alpha)4^{-m}/2. Ordered secant slopes bound quadrature width by KR(1-alpha)/n^2. Proportional cells use at most n+1 cells; the full acquisition count includes localization. An indistinguishable convex chord construction proves the retained lower bound; the uniform minimax order is scoped to N>=32.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: Exact point information differs from formula access and noisy numerical signs. The result omits bit complexity, is not a neural separation, and does not assert multivariate tractability.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Feasible-tail original-policy and all-action qualification; paid precision
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: Original V1 affine supports, endpoint enclosures, verified difference interval, constrained scalar outward minima and the unchanged epsilon_1=2^{-20} future-policy allowance.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: Strong convexity controls a possibly incorrect cut by the maximum of the two uncertain-slope endpoint defects. A fixed feasible tail density and midpoint global supports give a lower bound for every feasible original action; slope uncertainty takes the smaller constrained minimum. Upper policy cost includes the unchanged terminal allowance once. Boundaries, one-tail geometry and nonoptimal proposals remain admissible. The precision stationary equation and upward rounding concern a fixed declared positive-cost graph. Recursive continuation allowances remain dated and discounted.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: Certification changes information rather than the value of an unchanged policy; finite error ladders need not qualify every proposal. Conditional precision allocation is not a universal stopping optimum.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Bounded preliminary service and packed requests
reviewed_dependency_chain.location: Main Proposition 11, pages 27–29; Supplement section 16, pages 61–68
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: Original risk alpha in {1/2,3/4}, feasible 32-bit dyadic cut, cached original defect, positive-tail masks, resolutions 2 then 4, and unchanged frozen complete fallback.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: Zero-mass omission is exact, with fewer than 53 significant binary digits in the stated production domain. Two cached defect payloads plus (5+9)p cells give at most 30 outward payloads; four endpoint values plus six pairs give at most 16 floating values. The floating signs have no certification authority. All unsuccessful attempts and fallback remain paid. Packing is a bijection on paid requests and uses a singleton innovation axis; changed batch fallback may return different valid intervals, so bitwise equality is not assumed.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: The 30/16 bound is on preliminary terminal information, not wall-clock dominance or total compiler work. Actual policy contrasts and elapsed costs require the separately frozen records, including losses.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Coupled original-action witnesses and signed recursive gains
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: Bounded continuations, one shared original risk dual representation and feasible density, retained optimality slacks, and verified statewise continuation/gain brackets.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: Both common-density optimality slacks have the correct sign. The hinge remainder permits quantile atoms without claiming a positive margin exponent there. The complete-policy contrast enlarges each side by beta epsilon_1, not 2 beta epsilon_1. The signed recursion retains the original reference penalty, and restricting to near-active tails preserves the supremum without assuming attainment. Nonexpansiveness is explicitly for a fixed retained kernel set; adaptive set selection is separate.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: The common-witness obligation is attributed to frozen R111 work. These completed proofs do not turn separately unfinished R111/R112 numerical experiments into current execution evidence.

reviewed_dependency_chain.result: Corrections to original formulation and preserved applications
reviewed_dependency_chain.premises: The explicitly identified original author source and initial report; the displayed elementary counterexamples and conditional model formulas.
reviewed_dependency_chain.check: The original false joint-loss optimum, residual-only viscosity selection, incorrect portfolio/recursive-utility numbers and normalization, squared stochastic-trace objective bias, preference-domain/sign claims, frozen temporal-self deviation and joint Cournot interpretation are explicitly corrected. Positive beta, gamma and V_x are stated for the consumption monotonicity calculation. Their historical retention is not used as a premise for current results.
reviewed_dependency_chain.boundary: The diagnostics do not regenerate original portfolio, preference, temporal-self or game experiments, prove a general equilibrium, or establish singular recursive-utility existence. Current investment evidence is not substituted for those original applications.

remaining_scientific_scope: Method-neutral information/certification advances do not establish neural-specific superiority against equal-information conventional representations.
Current complete-cost and policy comparisons retain the strong conventional winners and all adverse Phase A/B/C observations; this proof audit does not re-estimate them.
Original-loss improvements, certification work savings, realized query counts, and elapsed service costs are distinct claims.
The fixed deterministic state/seed catalogue does not establish state-population, restart-population or application-level adoption claims.

Longer-horizon, genuinely multidimensional continuous-risk, action-aligned training, optimizer convergence and general NDU/FBSDE extensions retain their stated mathematical and experimental requirements.
Historical byte-complete read custody is not independent verification of every historical theorem, semantic interpretation of opaque binaries, or rerunning every experiment.
